Affected versions of brotli-decompressor are vulnerable to Improper Input Validation / Uncontrolled Resource Consumption. brotli-decompressor is a pure-Rust Brotli decompressor and is NOT affected by the memory-corruption out-of-bounds write in Google's Brotli C decoder. However, it had an analogous behavioral flaw: a block switch in a single-block-type category (a format error) was reported as NEEDS_MORE_INPUT, so in streaming mode the decoder buffers input waiting for a read that can never complete. An attacker controlling the Brotli stream can cause unbounded input buffering / a hang - a denial of service. Fixed in 6.2.0 by returning the correct format-error code. Impact is denial of service, not RCE.
